text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...I can feel a bit of a cool breeze. I guess
fall is on
its way.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Time sure does fly, huh? This fall... I'll be
running
the Tenno Sho with Tama.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...And then there's the Arima Kinen in
the winter
afterward. That'll be the
competition that
determines this year's
top racer.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I've grown a lot during this year's
camp.
choice_data_list: 夏合宿の成果を見せつけよう！

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
All that's left for me to do is to run as
fast as I
can!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so concludes our productive
summer camp.
